title: Ultrasound-assisted extraction of mangiferin from Mangifera pajang Kosterm. fruit using a choline chloride-based natural deep eutectic solvent: optimisation and antidiabetic activity
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00655D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muhammad Daniel Eazzat Mohd Rosdan, Mohd Azrie Awang, Mohammad Amil Zulhilmi Benjamin, Aniza Saini, Muhammad Naufal Qaweim Rushdy, Hasdian Mudin
Green ultrasound-assisted extraction using a NADES enables sustainable recovery of mangiferin from Mangifera pajang fruit and supports its potential use as a natural antidiabetic ingredient for functional food and nutraceutical applications.
